title: From job titles to jawlines: Using context voids to study generative AI systems

bias_targets.methodology: Anonymizing names on professional CVs, generating text descriptions and visual headshots using AI, prompting the AI to infer the perceived gender of the generated images, and conducting thematic analysis to identify disparities in trait attribution (e.g., associating 'confident' with men and 'kind' with women) and default gender representations.

Generating text descriptions and headshots from anonymized academic CVs and using qualitative thematic analysis to identify default racial and ethnic representations, such as an overrepresentation of Caucasian features despite a lack of demographic context in the inputs.

Conducting thematic analysis and open coding on AI-generated prompts and visual headshots to evaluate how the system infers and visually represents age based purely on professional CV achievements and timelines.

Analyzing the physical and environmental inferences in the AI-generated headshots to identify stereotypical visual characteristics (e.g., blazers, glasses, bookshelves) systematically associated with the academic profession.
